title: Pranav Mishra
subtitle: Essays and case studies by Pranav Mishra.

posts.title: Voice intake without an operator: how the mistakes get caught
posts.description: An insurance voice agent that takes onboarding calls by itself. How a misheard detail gets caught once nobody is listening in: a second transcript, code that owns the moments with consequences, and a link where the caller checks their own details.

posts.title: EONFOLK: a civilization game where models can only propose
posts.description: A small local-first game with eight citizens and a rule I also use for agents: the player, the models and the narrator can suggest what happens, but only one deterministic layer changes the world.

posts.title: KRYN: a coding agent on your Mac that can't hit a usage limit
posts.description: A coding agent that runs on a MacBook with a local 9B model: no usage limit, no API bill, and inference never leaves the laptop. How I grade it against plain OpenCode with tests it can't see, and what those tests caught.
